categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies address management logic in src/addrman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Corrects an ineffective freshness check in AddrMan that caused identical announcements relayed across multiple peers to artificially inflate an address's multiplicity in the new table. As the author notes, this is "just a small logic bugfix" that does not meaningfully impact adversarial resilience because attackers can easily vary timestamps directly.
